name: Abstain From Drugs
overview: Scripture calls believers to guard their hearts diligently, recognizing that life flows from within (Proverbs 4:23). The Bible warns against being deceived by substances like wine that can lead to mockery and rage (Proverbs 20:1) and instructs Christians to avoid behaviors such as drunkenness and excess (Romans 13:13; Ephesians 5:18). Instead, believers are urged to be transformed by renewing their minds to discern God's perfect will (Romans 12:2), thereby walking in holiness rather than the works of the flesh (Galatians 5:19). This teaches a Christ-centered approach to abstaining from drugs, emphasizing spiritual fullness over physical or mental impairment.
